RaggieSoft Help Studio • Native Offline F1 Help & Legacy .CHM Migration

Retire Legacy .CHM Files Without Losing Your HTML Help Workshop Projects.

Millions of desktop and industrial Windows applications still depend on 1990s Compiled HTML Help (.chm)—yet hh.exe renders inside retired Internet Explorer mshtml.dll, blocks over network shares under Mark-of-the-Web, lacks Dark Mode and High-Contrast themes, and fails modern Section 508 audits. RaggieSoft Help Studio imports existing HTML Help Workshop (.hhp, .hhc, .hhk, and .chm) projects cleanly and compiles both pluggable .rshm modules and standalone zero-dependency Win32 C++20 F1 help clients.

See Live Single-Source Web Manual → Download Installer Studio (Includes RaggieSoftHelp.exe)
Built on Our Proven Static /MT C++20 RaggieSoftHelp.exe Engine

Four Core Capabilities of RaggieSoft Help Studio

1. Turnkey HTML Help Workshop (.hhp / .chm) Importer

Point Help Studio at any existing .hhp project, .hhc Table of Contents, .hhk Keyword Index, C/C++/VB6 [MAP] & [ALIAS] context header IDs, or decompiled .chm archive to generate a clean, Git-diffable .rshp manifest in seconds.

2. Modular .rshm Plug-In OR Standalone Branded Client

Ship lightweight module.rshm.json documentation packs into a shared suite help viewer, OR stamp a 100% white-label standalone Win32 C++20 <YourProduct>Help.exe (x64 & ARM64) with zero .NET or WebView2 runtime dependencies.

3. Instant Named Pipe F1 Context Routing

Drop-in C/C++, C#/.NET 11, Delphi, and VB6 helper headers replace HtmlHelpW(..., HH_HELP_CONTEXT, id) with sub-5ms Named Pipe navigation—opening the exact dialog topic without spawning duplicate windows.

4. Single-Source Offline Help + Static SEO Web Portal + VPAT 2.5

Every .rshp build compiles offline desktop help, static WCAG 2.2 AA web documentation pages, and a procurement-ready HTML5 VPAT 2.5 conformance report from one set of Markdown/HTML5 chapters.
